parsed.post: Discarding the 1.008493 run; the batch size reduction to 262144 actually regressed from my best (1.002145). It seems 0.05 LR might be too high for the increased step count within the 5m budget. Moving to test MATRIX_LR=0.04 with TBS=262144 to see if slower, more frequent steps help.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 while keeping the halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to ensure stability and better convergence with more frequent optimizer steps.
